company.name: MAYDAY
company.shortDescription: Egyptian start-up based in Cairo providing real-time roadside assistance via location based mobile application to motorists in need.
company.description: MAYDAY utilizes a sharing economy model connecting "providers" in this case tow trucks or car drivers with motorists in need of assistance across Cairo & Giza. MAYDAY offers a range of services to its users including Battery jump start, Fuel delivery, tire change or Towing all delivered in less than 30 minutes. MAYDAY offers a safe and hassle free experience to its users while utilizing location-based services to guarantee a rapid response and dispatch process.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $28,000, or 58.33% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $216,635 to $453,982, a 2.1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
